state_cas_repair.repair_action: Decode each fixed byte chunk independently, concatenate decoded bytes, decode UTF-8 once, and replace the exact faulty blob by CAS.

state_cas_repair.recurrence_prevention: Never concatenate separately padded base64 chunks before decode; decode each chunk first or use an unpadded continuous stream.
